title: N-11 Retry and backoff: input and output records
description: Book 1.1.0. Input: any failure record that carries ../../shared/contracts.schema.json#/$defs/failure_body (every failure_kind of shared/contracts.xml#retry-owner), and N-02 lease.expired with end_reason start-grace. Outputs: attempt, regrant and dead on the shared committed envelope. Each output Commit also writes entity failure.handled:<failure_id> with precondition absent (it replaces handled_by) and runs tickets.transition. The operation keys N-11/attempt/<ticket>:<phase>:<n> and N-11/regrant/<lease_key>@<token> ride on the Commit request, not in the record; dead uses N-11/attempt/<ticket>:<phase>:<n> with n the attempt it would have been (4 after exhaustion).

failure.description: What N-11 reads from any failure record: the committed envelope plus failure_body. The owning node's own fields are copied into the next brief as detail. A record with fenced true is an echo of a run that was already fenced (shared/contracts.xml#terminal-report): N-11 marks it handled and acts on nothing.

failure_handled.description: Entity failure.handled:<failure_id>, written with precondition absent in the same Commit as the attempt, regrant or dead record, so a failure is acted on once; the entity write itself appends no record.

action.description: echo: a fenced report; wait: harness_mismatch (ticket to waiting) or head_moved (nothing charged, a new head gets a new grant); not_mine: a kind whose retry owner is another node (phase.failed before exhaust, admission-refused)

by_record.description: the attempt, regrant or dead record id; null for echo and not_mine

attempt.description: A charged retry: attempts.append plus tickets.transition to retry_wait (shared/contracts.xml#ticket-transitions). session is new or resume per shared/contracts.xml#retry-owner.

phase.description: the phase re-dispatched; after review.changes, gate red or merge.conflict it is worker

regrant.description: A free regrant: no attempt charged, ticket in_flight to ready and the lease regranted by leases.grant at the same attempt, after retry.claim_seconds or on the next tick for cap (shared/contracts.xml#timing).

lease.description: the lease that ended; the regrant is keyed by it

dead.description: Attempts exhausted, or a non-retryable kind: tickets.transition to dead and claims.release in the same Commit. N-28 shows one card.
